description: Utility functions for a React-based web application, including clipboard operations, file handling, image compression, device detection, window size hooks, and message processing.

methods.name: trimTopic
methods.description: Removes specific punctuation and quotes from the start and end of a topic string, fixing display issues in Indonesian language.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies text to clipboard, using Tauri API if available, otherwise fallback to document.execCommand.

methods.name: downloadAs
methods.description: Triggers download of text as a file, using Tauri dialog if available, otherwise creates a temporary anchor element.

methods.name: compressImage
methods.description: Compresses an image file to meet a maximum size by reducing quality and dimensions.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads JSON content from a file selected via an input element.

methods.name: isIOS
methods.description: Detects if the current device is an iOS device based on user agent.

methods.name: useWindowSize
methods.description: React hook to track window size changes.

methods.name: useMobileScreen
methods.description: React hook to determine if the screen width is below a mobile threshold.

methods.name: isFirefox
methods.description: Detects if the browser is Firefox.

methods.name: selectOrCopy
methods.description: Selects or copies content to clipboard, avoiding overwriting existing selection.

methods.name: getDomContentWidth
methods.description: Calculates the content width of a DOM element excluding padding.

methods.name: getOrCreateMeasureDom
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a hidden span element used for measuring text dimensions.

methods.name: autoGrowTextArea
methods.description: Calculates the number of rows a textarea should grow to based on its content.

methods.name: getCSSVar
methods.description: Retrieves a CSS variable value from the document.

methods.name: isMacOS
methods.description: Detects if the current OS is macOS or iOS based on user agent.

methods.name: getMessageTextContent
methods.description: Extracts text content from a message object.

methods.name: getMessageImages
methods.description: Extracts image URLs from a message object.

methods.name: isVisionModel
methods.description: Determines if a model string indicates a vision-related model.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Formats a date/time string into MM-DD or hh:mm based on whether it is before the current date.
